description: Andrew-direct 2026-07-08. The system's knowledge is scattered across ~313 docs/architecture/*.md, ~105 org/modules/graph/ source files, dozens of per-component PRDs, and agent memory -- there is no center of gravity, so infra work re-derives the system every time. This is a documentation + evaluation project, not a build-new-feature project. PRD docs/architecture/NFRA_SYSTEM_PRD.md.
